title: Searching a kitchen
target: How to work through a kitchen in R.E.P.O. without leaving anything behind, given that the room is fitted with its own counter, sink and fridge.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Enough light to see the counter

steps.because: the sink is named for the room and carries a collider object of its own (Kitchen Sink, Kitchen Sink_collider)

steps.do: Work along the counter before you open anything.
steps.because: each piece carries its own sheet, named after the piece (Kitchen Counter_Kitchen_Counter_BaseColor, Kitchen Sink_Kitchen_Sink_BaseColor)

steps.do: Open the fridge last, once the room is quiet.
steps.because: the fridge is named for the room as well, and again for the arctic version of it (Kitchen Fridge, Kitchen Fridge Arctic)

steps.do: Read the sign on the door before you commit to the room.
steps.because: the game signs a kitchen with a metal plate of its own (arctic sign kitchen)

steps.do: Expect the arctic version of the same room to be fitted differently.
steps.because: the arctic set names its own counter, sink and fridge (Kitchen Counter Arctic, Kitchen Sink Arctic)

steps.do: Do not treat a kitchen as a side room you can skip.
steps.because: the game names a start room of its own for a kitchen dining room (Start Room - Manor - Kitchen Dining Room)

commonMistakes: Walking past the sink because it looks like part of the wall.
Opening the fridge first and drawing attention to the noisiest piece.
Assuming the arctic kitchen holds the same pieces as the manor one.
Leaving the counter unsearched because a box was already in the way.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
